background_story: Krew was a sleek and agile ermine, known for his luxurious white coat and cunning nature. He lived in the snowy forests of the far north, where his ability to blend into the winter landscape made him a formidable hunter. Krew's thick fur and quick reflexes allowed him to thrive in the harsh environment, and he became a respected figure among the forest's creatures. However, Krew's most striking feature was his distinctive black tip, a small patch of fur on the end of his tail that he used to signal danger to his fellow ermines. This unique marking earned him the nickname 'Shadow Tip,' and his reputation as a clever and resourceful weasel spread throughout the land.
